meta.note: The Table: shadcn-vue (Tailwind v4) token names from decision 00009 with warm paper neutrals, an olive green brand color on `primary`, `ring` and `accent`, a saffron score stamp, a blue `success`, and fixed map colors. Breakpoints are the Tailwind v4 defaults. `app/ui/src/assets/main.css` has the same values.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page ground (`bg-background`): warm paper in light, near black in dark. Also the fill of outline buttons and dialogs.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Ink. Body text and headings on `background`, `card`, `popover` and `muted`. 14.9:1 light and 15.8:1 dark on `background`, 13.8:1 and 12.6:1 on `muted`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: A lighter paper. Fill of entry rows, subject rows, the score block, sheets and the destructive `Alert`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`. 16.4:1 light, 14.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Fill of floating surfaces: the `Select` list, the menus and `Toast`. The same as `card`.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`. 16.4:1 light, 14.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The olive green brand color. The one main action per screen (default `Button`, the round "Add review" of `BottomNav`), links, selected chips, selected `RatingInput` segments and the current section. As text or a mark: 6.2:1 light and 10.1:1 dark on `background`, 5.7:1 and 8.1:1 on `muted`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`: 6.7:1 light, 9.2:1 dark. Ink in the dark theme, never white.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary `Button` fill. Too close to `background` to mark a boundary on its own.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`. 13.8:1 light, 12.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: a photo that is loading or failed, the cover placeholder, the empty state icon.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Soft ink. Dates, names of reviewers, addresses, help text, "out of 10". Light: 6.3:1 on `background`, 6.9:1 on `card`, 5.8:1 on `muted` and `accent`. Dark: 8.3:1, 7.5:1, 6.6:1 and 6.1:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Olive tint. Hover fill of ghost and outline buttons and menu items, the current header section, tags, the `VisitorNote`, a journal tile without a photo, `Skeleton`.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`: 7.5:1 light, 9.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Deletes, API errors, invalid field borders and `FormMessage` text, never anything else. As text: 5.9:1 light and 7.7:1 dark on `background`, 6.4:1 and 7.0:1 on `card`. Always paired with a word or an icon. A delete button always says "Delete" and opens a confirming `Dialog`, because red and the olive brand are close in lightness.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a delete button or badge. 6.5:1 on `destructive` in light. In dark the fill is `destructive` at 50% over `background`, and white has 6.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations: the success `Toast` and the success `Alert` icon and title, such as "Review saved". Blue, not green, so it never reads as the brand or as the opposite of `destructive`. As text: 5.8:1 light and 9.0:1 dark on `background`, 6.3:1 and 8.1:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `success` fill: 6.2:1 light, 8.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: The score stamp, and nothing else: a round disc with the overall on a photo, and the restaurant pins of the maps. On light paper it has only 1.6:1, so a stamp sits on a photo with `shadow-stamp` or has the dark ring of a pin.

tokens.name: saffron-foreground
tokens.usage: The number in the score stamp. Ink in both themes: 9.6:1 light, 9.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines of cards, rows, dialogs and the bars, and the dotted leaders of the score block. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `TagInput`, outline buttons, chips and unselected `RatingInput` segments. Light: 3.3:1 on `background`, 3.6:1 on `card`, 3.0:1 on `muted`. Dark: 4.2:1, 3.8:1 and 3.3:1. Meets the 3:1 floor for control boundaries (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The focus outline of every interactive component: a solid 2px outline with a 2px offset, never at /50 as stock shadcn does. The same value as `primary`. 6.2:1 light and 10.1:1 dark on `background`.

tokens.name: map-pin
tokens.usage: Fill of a restaurant pin, the score stamp of the maps. Fixed in both themes, because the map tiles are light in both. The selected pin swaps it with `map-pin-foreground`.

tokens.name: map-pin-foreground
tokens.usage: The number and the 2px ring of a pin: 9.6:1 on `map-pin`, 14.5:1 on the land of the tiles. The fill of the selected pin, with the number in `map-pin`.

tokens.name: map-cluster
tokens.usage: Fill of a pin with a count, for restaurants that are less than 44px apart. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: map-cluster-foreground
tokens.usage: The count and the 3px ring of a cluster pin: 6.6:1 on `map-cluster`.

tokens.name: map-location
tokens.usage: The blue dot of the preferred location, with a white ring and a halo at 18%. Fixed in both themes.

families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The `h1` of a screen from `md` (`font-serif text-[46px] font-semibold`).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: The `h1` of a screen below `md`, one per screen: the name of a subject, the title of a review, "On the table".

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title on a screen: "Every visit", "Your journal", "Scores".

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Group title: "Favorites", "Lists", "More from Ana", the heading of `VisitorNote`.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: The title of a review in the photo variant of `EntryCard`.

styles.name: name
styles.usage: The name in a subject row, the title in the row variant of `EntryCard`, an item of the list menu.

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: The overall in the score block of a subject or a review, with "out of 10" below it. Lining tabular figures.

styles.name: score-lg
styles.usage: The overall at the end of a row: subject rows, entry rows, the timeline of visits.

styles.name: score-stamp
styles.usage: The number in the `md` score stamp (56px) on the photo of an entry.

styles.name: score-line
styles.usage: The value of each score in the score block, after the dotted leader.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Friendly staff and great pasta. The cacio e pepe is the reason to come back.
styles.usage: The feedback of a review on its page. At most `reading-max` wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Family-run trattoria with handmade pasta and a small terrace.
styles.usage: Descriptions and other long text. Form fields use 16px below `md`, so phones do not zoom.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Group labels of the table and the journal, and the subject above an entry title. Set in `all-small-caps` in `primary`; the text itself stays in sentence case.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, help text and counts, in `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tags, the day on a journal tile, the ends of a `RatingInput`.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: The labels of `BottomNav`, under their 22px icons.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Gap between the lines of a row: kicker, title and meta.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Select list padding, gap between `RatingInput` segments.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between the lines of a page header, and between tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label, its field and its message (`gap-2`); gap between chips and buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between the thumbnail and the text of a row; padding of a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side padding of a page below `sm`, padding of a sheet, gap between rows of a list.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between entries on the table, padding of the score block and `VisitorNote`.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Side padding of a page from `sm`, dialog padding, gap between page sections on a phone.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections from `md`.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Select items and menu items (`--radius` minus 4px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Badges and tags, `RatingInput` segments, skeletons (`--radius` minus 2px).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base `--radius` (0.625rem). Inputs, textareas, selects, dialogs, alerts and thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Rows: subject rows, entry rows, list rows (`--radius` plus 4px).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The photo of an entry, the score block, `VisitorNote` and side cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and circles: every button, chip, the search field, the view switch, the score stamp, map pins and `Avatar`.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs and outline buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-stamp
tokens.usage: The score stamp on a photo. It lifts the saffron disc off light photos.

tokens.name: shadow-pin
tokens.usage: Map pins, cluster pins and the round "Add review" button of `BottomNav`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The open `Select` list and the menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and `Toast`.

breakpoint.note: Tailwind v4 default breakpoints. Layout is mobile first: style the phone, then add `sm:`, `md:` and up.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: `sm:`. The page side padding grows from 16px to 24px. Two-column forms start here.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: `md:`. `BottomNav` goes away, and `AppHeader` shows the sections, "Add review" and the account menu. Form fields drop from 16px to 15px text.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: `lg:`. The restaurants page shows the list and the map side by side. The restaurant page puts its map beside the details.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: `xl:`. No layout change.

tokens.name: breakpoint-2xl
tokens.usage: `2xl:`. No layout change; content stays at `content-max`.

size.note: Page widths and fixed sizes. Center the content column with `mx-auto` and pad it with `px-4` (16px), `sm:px-6` (24px).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Width of the page column and the header content (`max-w-6xl`): the table, lists of subjects, the journal.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Width of forms, sign in and the text of a review (`max-w-2xl`). Keeps lines near 70 characters.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of `AppHeader` below `md`.

tokens.name: header-height-md
tokens.usage: Height of `AppHeader` from `md`.

tokens.name: bottom-nav-height
tokens.usage: Height of `BottomNav`, above `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`. Pages below `md` get this much bottom padding.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: The least height of buttons, chips, menu items and links outside a sentence. `RatingInput` segments are at least 32 by 44px.

tokens.name: stamp-sm
tokens.usage: The score stamp on a journal tile.

tokens.name: stamp-md
tokens.usage: The score stamp on the photo of an entry.

tokens.name: pin
tokens.usage: A map pin. The selected pin is 52px. A cluster pin is 46px.

zIndex.note: Stacking order, low to high. Use only these values.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The sticky `AppHeader` and the fixed `BottomNav` (`z-40`). Content scrolls under them.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: `Select` lists, the `UserMenu` and `ThemeToggle` menus, the `Dialog` overlay and panel (`z-50`, shadcn-vue default).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: `Toast` messages (`z-[100]`). They stay above an open dialog and `BottomNav`.
